evidence: The skill defines this row as checking that judges are told to exercise the relevant behavior. The frozen functional prompt requires six-second idle intervals followed by real click/key/input actions (157-158), active cancellation and six-second observation windows (178-192), timed real edits and Auto-run toggling (406-409), two actual theme switches with preserved working content (473), and a ten-second nested-callback observation (486). Polish requires real keyboard navigation and a usable 390x844 viewport; Visual requires desktop/mobile comparison and both themes (visual/prompt.md:44-46; visual/judge.toml:99). A preview whose handlers die after five seconds would fail S03; a conforming app using mobile tabs/drawers, native focus and either initial theme is explicitly accepted. Verified all 102 current_golden artifact hashes, its current prompt/criterion hashes and all 22 actual app-file hashes against frozen bytes. Raw post-results facts.S03.later_interactions records 6103/6103 ms idle waits and click/key/input marker increments; pre-results records two theme actions; surface-results records keyboard navigation without pointer and edit/Run/preview/Clear at 390x844, matching surface_flow.cjs:21-34. This supports the prescribed probes with scripted product evidence only. Full configured judge execution/workload and scores remain unmeasured, as the index states; this row does not clear those separate runtime requirements.
